meaning: Two entailments by chaining: potency to being moved, to a mover, to its act, to its priority, with non-simultaneity excluding a self-mover; five omission models (a dormant potency, motion without a mover, a mover not in act, a self-mover in act and potency, a mover without priority); a model of all five; a model of every prima via premise and the mover-priority bridge in which the first mover moved by none is a first being in potency to a respect in which nothing is moved; and the contradiction of 'every potency is being actualized' with a potency not being actualized.
